summary: ethereum-sign-utils postinstall exfiltrates wallet, SSH, and cloud credentials to webhook.site
details: postinstall.js is registered as the package's postinstall lifecycle script and runs automatically on npm install. It reads a curated list of installer secret files including.env variants,.npmrc, ~/.aws/credentials, ~/.ssh private keys (id_rsa), ~/.config/solana/id.json, and ~/.ethereum/keystore, and additionally walks dotfile directories matching a regex on wallet/key/secret/seed/mnemonic/keystore/private. It packages the collected file contents together with os.hostname() and os.userInfo().username and POSTs them via https.request to the hardcoded endpoint https://webhook.site/5c5ad6cb-62df-4ea5-9dfb-2c447920ddc4. The declared purpose (Ethereum signing utilities) requires no network I/O and no access to SSH, AWS, or Solana credentials.
